page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The system is equipped with 310.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.46 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel processing acceleration are delivered by a single NVIDIA A10 GPU based on the Ampere architecture, featuring 24 GB of dedicated VRAM.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. A key architectural tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. This configuration makes the instance highly dependent on network performance for data-intensive I/O operations, though the 16 Gbps baseline helps mitigate potential bottlenecks.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier performance in large language model inference. For a small 135M model, it achieves prompt processing speeds of 9711.08 tokens per second and text generation speeds of 456.51 tokens per second. With a medium 7B model, prompt processing reaches 2509.43 tokens per second and text generation reaches 90.44 tokens per second, both placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Geekbench image processing also show strong results in the top 25%.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of a dedicated 48-core Intel Xeon CPU and an enterprise-grade NVIDIA A10 GPU offers a balanced resource density for specialized workloads without the overhead of multi-GPU configurations. The instance is suited for low-to-medium parameter LLM inference, image processing, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and cryptographic operations.
